caseNameFull: Brown v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Messrs. Peter F. Dunne, Lloyd M. Robbins, and Arthur B. Dunne for petitioner. Solicitor General Biggs and Messrs. Sewall Key, Wm. Cutler Thompson, and Erwin N. Griswold for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit . Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit granted, limited to the question of the deduction on account of reserve.
